length.evidence: 100.0 dimension under TOP and FRONT views

width.evidence: 60.0 dimension on TOP view and under RIGHT view

height.evidence: 70.0 dimension on FRONT and RIGHT views

plate_thickness.evidence: thickness of bottom strip in FRONT view and side strip in TOP/RIGHT views, proportioned to 70 mm height

gusset_thickness.evidence: width of central rib strip in TOP and FRONT views, similar to plate thickness

gusset_height.evidence: triangular rib in RIGHT view rises from base top to below top of vertical plate

gusset_length.evidence: foot of triangular rib in RIGHT view measured proportionally along 60 mm base

hole_diameter.evidence: diameter of circular holes in FRONT and TOP views proportioned to 100 mm length

hole_end_offset.evidence: hole centres in FRONT/TOP views at approximately quarter and three-quarter length positions
